scientific_integrity: All-iteration statements are proved algebraically. Finite numerical checks are supplementary diagnostics; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only exactly two distinct positive normal-matrix eigenvalues and 0 < omega <= 1/lambda_max. Probes must be shared across iterations. The exact binomial law applies only to a flat rank-one projector. No assertion about confidence-interval coverage under arbitrary noise-dependent stopping, finite precision, or historical priority.
title: An exact all-iteration Rademacher probing frontier for two-spectrum Landweber covariance
